title: Add Role-Based Access Control (Admin, Coordinator, Student)
body:
Implement role-based user management with different permissions and dashboards for Admin, Club Coordinator, and Student roles.

## Requirements
- Admin role: approve/reject clubs and events, manage users, view all system data
- Coordinator role: create clubs, manage events, oversee registrations
- Student role: browse clubs, register for events, manage profile
- Role-based route protection on both frontend and backend

title: Add Club/Organization Management
body:
Implement full club management system as separate entities from activities.

## Requirements
- Create and manage clubs with categories (Technical, Cultural, Sports, Social Service, Arts, Literary)
- Assign coordinators to clubs
- Track club membership
- Club approval workflow (pending → approved by admins)
- Club-specific pages and details

title: Create Role-Specific Dashboards

## Requirements

- Coordinator dashboard: manage club activities, view registrations, handle approvals
- Admin dashboard: approval queues, user management, system overview

title: Migrate to MongoDB for Persistent Storage
body:
Replace in-memory storage with MongoDB for scalable data persistence.

## Requirements
- Set up MongoDB connection with PyMongo/Motor
- Create database schemas for Users, Clubs, Events, Registrations
- Migrate existing activity data
- Implement proper data relationships
- Handle database errors gracefully

title: Expand API to 30+ Endpoints
body:
Build comprehensive RESTful API with proper structure.

## Current Status
- 2 endpoints (GET /activities, POST /activities/{activity_name}/signup)

## Requirements
- Authentication endpoints (register, login, profile management)
- User management endpoints (CRUD operations)
- Club management endpoints (CRUD + approval/rejection)
- Event management endpoints (CRUD + approval/rejection)
- Registration management endpoints (list, create, cancel)
- Proper error handling and validation
- API documentation with Swagger/OpenAPI
